title: DbSessionContext
description: Transaction-local PostgreSQL settings every repository applies before its first statement (TI v1.0 s8, s8.1; Eng v1.4 'repository sets transaction-local tenant context'). Keys are PostgreSQL setting names. Values are derived only from the server-side RequestContext (or, for background workers, from the validated event envelope of the unit of work) and applied with set_config(name, value, true) inside the transaction, never at session level, because pooled connections are reused. RLS policies read the tenant through sf_platform.current_tenant_id(), never through current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid directly: after a SET LOCAL transaction ends, a reused session holds '' and the direct cast raises an error (see docs/audits/CONTRACT-REVIEW-001.md finding CR-01).

app.tenant_id.description: Required for any transaction that touches TENANT_SCOPED or JURISDICTION_SCOPED tables or writes outbox_event/inbox_event. Omitted (not empty) for platform and citizen-only transactions; RLS then returns no tenant rows (fail closed).
